mechanism: Both drugs can cause renal impairment and hypocalcemia; enalapril reduces glomerular filtration pressure while zoledronic acid is nephrotoxic, increasing risk of acute kidney injury and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium) before and after zoledronic acid infusion; ensure adequate hydration and consider dose adjustment of enalapril if renal function declines.
